audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Exodus / Shemot text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for frogs, gnats/lice, swarm, Pharaoh's partial concessions, distinction of Goshen, and hardening.

verses.restored: YHWH said to Moses, Come to Pharaoh, and say to him, Thus says YHWH: Send my people away, so they may serve/worship me.

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, Go unto Pharaoh, and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Let my people go, that they may serve me.

modern.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Go to Pharaoh and tell him that this is what the LORD says: ‘Let My people go, so that they may worship Me.

original.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה בֹּ֖א אֶל פַּרְעֹ֑ה וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֵלָ֗יו כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה שַׁלַּ֥ח אֶת עַמִּ֖י וְיַֽעַבְדֻֽנִי

verses.restored: But if you refuse to send, look, I myself will strike all your border with frogs.

familiar.text: And if thou refuse to let them go, behold, I will smite all thy borders with frogs:

modern.text: But if you refuse to let them go, I will plague your whole country with frogs.

original.text: וְאִם מָאֵ֥ן אַתָּ֖ה לְשַׁלֵּ֑חַ הִנֵּ֣ה אָנֹכִ֗י נֹגֵ֛ף אֶת כָּל גְּבוּלְךָ֖ בַּֽצְפַרְדְּעִֽים

verses.restored: The Nile will swarm with frogs; they will go up and come into your house, your bedroom, your bed, house of your servants, among your people, into your ovens and kneading bowls.

familiar.text: And the river shall bring forth frogs abundantly, which shall go up and come into thine house, and into thy bedchamber, and upon thy bed, and into the house of thy servants, and upon thy people, and into thine ovens, and into thy kneadingtroughs:

modern.text: The Nile will teem with frogs, and they will come into your palace and up to your bedroom and onto your bed, into the houses of your officials and your people, and into your ovens and kneading bowls.

original.text: וְשָׁרַ֣ץ הַיְאֹר֮ צְפַרְדְּעִים֒ וְעָלוּ֙ וּבָ֣אוּ בְּבֵיתֶ֔ךָ וּבַחֲדַ֥ר מִשְׁכָּבְךָ֖ וְעַל מִטָּתֶ֑ךָ וּבְבֵ֤ית עֲבָדֶ֨יךָ֙ וּבְעַמֶּ֔ךָ וּבְתַנּוּרֶ֖יךָ וּבְמִשְׁאֲרוֹתֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: Upon you, upon your people, and upon all your servants the frogs will go up.

familiar.text: And the frogs shall come up both on thee, and upon thy people, and upon all thy servants.

modern.text: The frogs will come up on you and your people and all your officials.’”

original.text: וּבְכָ֥ה וּֽבְעַמְּךָ֖ וּבְכָל עֲבָדֶ֑יךָ יַעֲל֖וּ הַֽצְפַרְדְּעִֽים

verses.restored: YHWH said to Moses, Say to Aaron, Stretch your hand with your staff over rivers, canals, and pools, and bring up frogs upon land of Egypt.

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch forth thine hand with thy rod over the streams, over the rivers, and over the ponds, and cause frogs to come up upon the land of Egypt.

modern.text: And the LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your hand with your staff over the rivers and canals and ponds, and cause the frogs to come up onto the land of Egypt.’”

original.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָה֮ אֶל מֹשֶׁה֒ אֱמֹ֣ר אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֗ן נְטֵ֤ה אֶת יָדְךָ֙ בְּמַטֶּ֔ךָ עַל הַ֨נְּהָרֹ֔ת עַל הַיְאֹרִ֖ים וְעַל הָאֲגַמִּ֑ים וְהַ֥עַל אֶת הַֽצְפַרְדְּעִ֖ים עַל אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם

verses.restored: Aaron stretched his hand over waters of Egypt, and frogs came up and covered land of Egypt.

familiar.text: And Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt; and the frogs came up, and covered the land of Egypt.

modern.text: So Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt, and the frogs came up and covered the land of Egypt.

original.text: וַיֵּ֤ט אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶת יָד֔וֹ עַ֖ל מֵימֵ֣י מִצְרָ֑יִם וַתַּ֨עַל֙ הַצְּפַרְדֵּ֔עַ וַתְּכַ֖ס אֶת אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם

verses.restored: The magicians did so with their secret arts and brought up frogs upon land of Egypt.

familiar.text: And the magicians did so with their enchantments, and brought up frogs upon the land of Egypt.

modern.text: But the magicians did the same thing by their magic arts, and they also brought frogs up onto the land of Egypt.

original.text: וַיַּֽעֲשׂוּ כֵ֥ן הַֽחֲרְטֻמִּ֖ים בְּלָטֵיהֶ֑ם וַיַּעֲל֥וּ אֶת הַֽצְפַרְדְּעִ֖ים עַל אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם

verses.restored: Pharaoh called Moses and Aaron and said, Plead with YHWH to remove frogs from me and from my people, and I will send the people, so they may sacrifice to YHWH.

familiar.text: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron, and said, Intreat the LORD, that he may take away the frogs from me, and from my people; and I will let the people go, that they may do sacrifice unto the LORD.

modern.text: Pharaoh summoned Moses and Aaron and said, “Pray to the LORD to take the frogs away from me and my people. Then I will let your people go, that they may sacrifice to the LORD.”

original.text: וַיִּקְרָ֨א פַרְעֹ֜ה לְמֹשֶׁ֣ה וּֽלְאַהֲרֹ֗ן וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הַעְתִּ֣ירוּ אֶל יְהוָ֔ה וְיָסֵר֙ הַֽצְפַרְדְּעִ֔ים מִמֶּ֖נִּי וּמֵֽעַמִּ֑י וַאֲשַׁלְּחָה֙ אֶת הָעָ֔ם וְיִזְבְּח֖וּ לַיהוָֽה

verses.restored: Moses said to Pharaoh, Have honor over me: for when shall I plead for you, your servants, and your people, to cut off frogs from you and your houses, only in Nile they will remain?

familiar.text: And Moses said unto Pharaoh, Glory over me: when shall I intreat for thee, and for thy servants, and for thy people, to destroy the frogs from thee and thy houses, that they may remain in the river only?

modern.text: Moses said to Pharaoh, “You may have the honor over me. When shall I pray for you and your officials and your people that the frogs (except for those in the Nile) may be taken away from you and your houses?”

original.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֣ה לְפַרְעֹה֮ הִתְפָּאֵ֣ר עָלַי֒ לְמָתַ֣י אַעְתִּ֣יר לְךָ֗ וְלַעֲבָדֶ֨יךָ֙ וּֽלְעַמְּךָ֔ לְהַכְרִית֙ הַֽצֲפַרְדְּעִ֔ים מִמְּךָ֖ וּמִבָּתֶּ֑יךָ רַ֥ק בַּיְאֹ֖ר תִּשָּׁאַֽרְנָה

verses.restored: He said, Tomorrow. Moses said, According to your word, so that you may know there is none like YHWH our Divine.

familiar.text: And he said, To morrow. And he said, Be it according to thy word: that thou mayest know that there is none like unto the LORD our God.

modern.text: “Tomorrow,” Pharaoh answered. “May it be as you say,” Moses replied, “so that you may know that there is no one like the LORD our God.

original.text: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר לְמָחָ֑ר וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ כִּדְבָ֣רְךָ֔ לְמַ֣עַן תֵּדַ֔ע כִּי אֵ֖ין כַּיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ

verses.restored: The frogs shall turn aside from you, from your houses, from your servants, and from your people; only in Nile they shall remain.

familiar.text: And the frogs shall depart from thee, and from thy houses, and from thy servants, and from thy people; they shall remain in the river only.

modern.text: The frogs will depart from you and your houses and your officials and your people; they will remain only in the Nile.”

original.text: וְסָר֣וּ הַֽצְפַרְדְּעִ֗ים מִמְּךָ֙ וּמִבָּ֣תֶּ֔יךָ וּמֵעֲבָדֶ֖יךָ וּמֵעַמֶּ֑ךָ רַ֥ק בַּיְאֹ֖ר תִּשָּׁאַֽרְנָה

verses.restored: Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh, and Moses cried to YHWH concerning the frogs he had set upon Pharaoh.

familiar.text: And Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh: and Moses cried unto the LORD because of the frogs which he had brought against Pharaoh.

modern.text: After Moses and Aaron had left Pharaoh, Moses cried out to the LORD for help with the frogs that He had brought against Pharaoh.

original.text: וַיֵּצֵ֥א מֹשֶׁ֛ה וְאַהֲרֹ֖ן מֵעִ֣ם פַּרְעֹ֑ה וַיִּצְעַ֤ק מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל יְהוָ֔ה עַל דְּבַ֥ר הַֽצְפַרְדְּעִ֖ים אֲשֶׁר שָׂ֥ם לְפַרְעֹֽה

verses.restored: YHWH did according to word of Moses; frogs died from houses, courtyards, and fields.

familiar.text: And the LORD did according to the word of Moses; and the frogs died out of the houses, out of the villages, and out of the fields.

modern.text: And the LORD did as Moses requested, and the frogs in the houses, the courtyards, and the fields died.

original.text: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ יְהוָ֖ה כִּדְבַ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיָּמֻ֨תוּ֙ הַֽצְפַרְדְּעִ֔ים מִן הַבָּתִּ֥ים מִן הַחֲצֵרֹ֖ת וּמִן הַשָּׂדֹֽת

verses.restored: They piled them in heaps and heaps, and the land stank.

familiar.text: And they gathered them together upon heaps: and the land stank.

modern.text: They were piled into countless heaps, and there was a terrible stench in the land.

original.text: וַיִּצְבְּר֥וּ אֹתָ֖ם חֳמָרִ֣ם חֳמָרִ֑ם וַתִּבְאַ֖שׁ הָאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: But Pharaoh saw there was relief, and he made his heart heavy and did not listen to them, as YHWH had spoken.

familiar.text: But when Pharaoh saw that there was respite, he hardened his heart, and hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had said.

modern.text: When Pharaoh saw that there was relief, however, he hardened his heart and would not listen to Moses and Aaron, just as the LORD had said. The Third Plague: Gnats

original.text: וַיַּ֣רְא פַּרְעֹ֗ה כִּ֤י הָֽיְתָה֙ הָֽרְוָחָ֔ה וְהַכְבֵּד֙ אֶת לִבּ֔וֹ וְלֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖ע אֲלֵהֶ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: YHWH said to Moses, Say to Aaron, Stretch your staff and strike dust of earth, and it shall become gnats/lice in all land of Egypt.

familiar.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch out thy rod, and smite the dust of the land, that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt.

modern.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your staff and strike the dust of the earth, that it may turn into swarms of gnats throughout the land of Egypt.’”

original.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָה֮ אֶל מֹשֶׁה֒ אֱמֹר֙ אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֔ן נְטֵ֣ה אֶֽת מַטְּךָ֔ וְהַ֖ךְ אֶת עֲפַ֣ר הָאָ֑רֶץ וְהָיָ֥ה לְכִנִּ֖ם בְּכָל אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם

verses.restored: They did so; Aaron stretched his hand with his staff and struck dust of earth, and gnats/lice were on human and beast; all dust of earth became gnats/lice in all land of Egypt.

familiar.text: And they did so; for Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod, and smote the dust of the earth, and it became lice in man, and in beast; all the dust of the land became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.

modern.text: This they did, and when Aaron stretched out his hand with his staff and struck the dust of the earth, gnats came upon man and beast. All the dust of the earth turned into gnats throughout the land of Egypt.

original.text: וַיַּֽעֲשׂוּ כֵ֗ן וַיֵּט֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן אֶת יָד֤וֹ בְמַטֵּ֨הוּ֙ וַיַּךְ֙ אֶת עֲפַ֣ר הָאָ֔רֶץ וַתְּהִי֙ הַכִּנָּ֔ם בָּאָדָ֖ם וּבַבְּהֵמָ֑ה כָּל עֲפַ֥ר הָאָ֛רֶץ הָיָ֥ה כִנִּ֖ים בְּכָל אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם

verses.restored: The magicians did so with their secret arts to bring out gnats/lice, but they were not able. And gnats/lice were on human and beast.

familiar.text: And the magicians did so with their enchantments to bring forth lice, but they could not: so there were lice upon man, and upon beast.

modern.text: The magicians tried to produce gnats using their magic arts, but they could not. And the gnats remained on man and beast.

original.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כֵ֨ן הַחַרְטֻמִּ֧ים בְּלָטֵיהֶ֛ם לְהוֹצִ֥יא אֶת הַכִּנִּ֖ים וְלֹ֣א יָכֹ֑לוּ וַתְּהִי֙ הַכִּנָּ֔ם בָּאָדָ֖ם וּבַבְּהֵמָֽה

verses.restored: The magicians said to Pharaoh, This is finger of Divine. But Pharaoh's heart was strong/hardened, and he did not listen to them, as YHWH had spoken.

familiar.text: Then the magicians said unto Pharaoh, This is the finger of God: and Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had said.

modern.text: “This is the finger of God,” the magicians said to Pharaoh. But Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he would not listen to them, just as the LORD had said. The Fourth Plague: Flies

original.text: וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ הַֽחַרְטֻמִּים֙ אֶל פַּרְעֹ֔ה אֶצְבַּ֥ע אֱלֹהִ֖ים הִ֑וא וַיֶּחֱזַ֤ק לֵב פַּרְעֹה֙ וְלֹֽא שָׁמַ֣ע אֲלֵהֶ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: YHWH said to Moses, Rise early in morning and stand before Pharaoh; look, he goes out to the water. Say to him, Thus says YHWH: Send my people away, so they may serve/worship me.

familiar.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh; lo, he cometh forth to the water; and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Let my people go, that they may serve me.

modern.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Get up early in the morning, and when Pharaoh goes out to the water, stand before him and tell him that this is what the LORD says: ‘Let My people go, so that they may worship Me.

original.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֗ה הַשְׁכֵּ֤ם בַּבֹּ֨קֶר֙ וְהִתְיַצֵּב֙ לִפְנֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔ה הִנֵּ֖ה יוֹצֵ֣א הַמָּ֑יְמָה וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֵלָ֗יו כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה שַׁלַּ֥ח עַמִּ֖י וְיַֽעַבְדֻֽנִי

verses.restored: For if you do not send my people away, look, I send swarm upon you, your servants, your people, and your houses; houses of Egypt will be full of swarm, and even ground on which they are.

familiar.text: Else, if thou wilt not let my people go, behold, I will send swarms of flies upon thee, and upon thy servants, and upon thy people, and into thy houses: and the houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms of flies, and also the ground whereon they are.

modern.text: But if you will not let My people go, I will send swarms of flies upon you and your officials and your people and your houses. The houses of the Egyptians and even the ground where they stand will be full of flies.

original.text: כִּ֣י אִם אֵינְךָ֮ מְשַׁלֵּ֣חַ אֶת עַמִּי֒ הִנְנִי֩ מַשְׁלִ֨יחַ בְּךָ֜ וּבַעֲבָדֶ֧יךָ וּֽבְעַמְּךָ֛ וּבְבָתֶּ֖יךָ אֶת הֶעָרֹ֑ב וּמָ֨לְא֜וּ בָּתֵּ֤י מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ אֶת הֶ֣עָרֹ֔ב וְגַ֥ם הָאֲדָמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁר הֵ֥ם עָלֶֽיהָ

verses.restored: But on that day I will set apart land of Goshen, where my people stand, so no swarm will be there, so that you may know that I, YHWH, am in midst of land.

familiar.text: And I will sever in that day the land of Goshen, in which my people dwell, that no swarms of flies shall be there; to the end thou mayest know that I am the LORD in the midst of the earth.

modern.text: But on that day I will give special treatment to the land of Goshen, where My people live; no swarms of flies will be found there. In this way you will know that I, the LORD, am in the land.

original.text: וְהִפְלֵיתִי֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא אֶת אֶ֣רֶץ גֹּ֗שֶׁן אֲשֶׁ֤ר עַמִּי֙ עֹמֵ֣ד עָלֶ֔יהָ לְבִלְתִּ֥י הֱיֽוֹת שָׁ֖ם עָרֹ֑ב לְמַ֣עַן תֵּדַ֔ע כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בְּקֶ֥רֶב הָאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: I will place distinction between my people and your people; tomorrow this sign will happen.

familiar.text: And I will put a division between my people and thy people: to morrow shall this sign be.

modern.text: I will make a distinction between My people and your people. This sign will take place tomorrow.’”

original.text: וְשַׂמְתִּ֣י פְדֻ֔ת בֵּ֥ין עַמִּ֖י וּבֵ֣ין עַמֶּ֑ךָ לְמָחָ֥ר יִהְיֶ֖ה הָאֹ֥ת הַזֶּֽה

verses.restored: YHWH did so; a heavy swarm came into house of Pharaoh and house of his servants and in all land of Egypt; the land was ruined because of swarm.

familiar.text: And the LORD did so; and there came a grievous swarm of flies into the house of Pharaoh, and into his servants’ houses, and into all the land of Egypt: the land was corrupted by reason of the swarm of flies.

modern.text: And the LORD did so. Thick swarms of flies poured into Pharaoh’s palace and into the houses of his officials. Throughout Egypt the land was ruined by swarms of flies.

original.text: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ יְהוָה֙ כֵּ֔ן וַיָּבֹא֙ עָרֹ֣ב כָּבֵ֔ד בֵּ֥יתָה פַרְעֹ֖ה וּבֵ֣ית עֲבָדָ֑יו וּבְכָל אֶ֧רֶץ מִצְרַ֛יִם תִּשָּׁחֵ֥ת הָאָ֖רֶץ מִפְּנֵ֥י הֶעָרֹֽב

verses.restored: Pharaoh called Moses and Aaron and said, Go, sacrifice to your Divine in the land.

familiar.text: And Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron, and said, Go ye, sacrifice to your God in the land.

modern.text: Then Pharaoh summoned Moses and Aaron and said, “Go, sacrifice to your God within this land.”

original.text: וַיִּקְרָ֣א פַרְעֹ֔ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֖ה וּֽלְאַהֲרֹ֑ן וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לְכ֛וּ זִבְח֥וּ לֵֽאלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם בָּאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: Moses said, It is not established/right to do so, for we will sacrifice to YHWH our Divine what is abomination to Egypt. Look, if we sacrifice what is abomination to Egypt before their eyes, will they not stone us?

familiar.text: And Moses said, It is not meet so to do; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to the LORD our God: lo, shall we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes, and will they not stone us?

modern.text: But Moses replied, “It would not be right to do that, because the sacrifices we offer to the LORD our God would be detestable to the Egyptians. If we offer sacrifices that are detestable before the Egyptians, will they not stone us?

original.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֗ה לֹ֤א נָכוֹן֙ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת כֵּ֔ן כִּ֚י תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת מִצְרַ֔יִם נִזְבַּ֖ח לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ הֵ֣ן נִזְבַּ֞ח אֶת תּוֹעֲבַ֥ת מִצְרַ֛יִם לְעֵינֵיהֶ֖ם וְלֹ֥א יִסְקְלֻֽנוּ

verses.restored: A three-day journey into wilderness we will go, and we will sacrifice to YHWH our Divine, as he says to us.

familiar.text: We will go three days’ journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to the LORD our God, as he shall command us.

modern.text: We must make a three-day journey into the wilderness and sacrifice to the LORD our God as He commands us.”

original.text: דֶּ֚רֶךְ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֔ים נֵלֵ֖ךְ בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וְזָבַ֨חְנוּ֙ לַֽיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר יֹאמַ֥ר אֵלֵֽינוּ

verses.restored: Pharaoh said, I myself will send you, and you shall sacrifice to YHWH your Divine in wilderness; only do not go very far. Plead for me.

familiar.text: And Pharaoh said, I will let you go, that ye may sacrifice to the LORD your God in the wilderness; only ye shall not go very far away: intreat for me.

modern.text: Pharaoh answered, “I will let you go and sacrifice to the LORD your God in the wilderness, but you must not go very far. Now pray for me.”

original.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֗ה אָנֹכִ֞י אֲשַׁלַּ֤ח אֶתְכֶם֙ וּזְבַחְתֶּ֞ם לַיהוָ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר רַ֛ק הַרְחֵ֥ק לֹא תַרְחִ֖יקוּ לָלֶ֑כֶת הַעְתִּ֖ירוּ בַּעֲדִֽי

verses.restored: Moses said, Look, I go out from you and will plead to YHWH, and the swarm will turn aside from Pharaoh, his servants, and his people tomorrow; only let Pharaoh not act deceitfully again by not sending the people to sacrifice to YHWH.

familiar.text: And Moses said, Behold, I go out from thee, and I will intreat the LORD that the swarms of flies may depart from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people, to morrow: but let not Pharaoh deal deceitfully any more in not letting the people go to sacrifice to the LORD.

modern.text: “As soon as I leave you,” Moses said, “I will pray to the LORD, so that tomorrow the swarms of flies will depart from Pharaoh and his officials and his people. But Pharaoh must not act deceitfully again by refusing to let the people go and sacrifice to the LORD.”

verses.restored: Moses went out from Pharaoh and pleaded to YHWH.

familiar.text: And Moses went out from Pharaoh, and intreated the LORD.

modern.text: Then Moses left Pharaoh and prayed to the LORD,

verses.restored: YHWH did according to word of Moses and turned aside the swarm from Pharaoh, his servants, and his people; not one remained.

familiar.text: And the LORD did according to the word of Moses; and he removed the swarms of flies from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people; there remained not one.

modern.text: and the LORD did as Moses requested. He removed the swarms of flies from Pharaoh and his officials and his people; not one fly remained.

verses.restored: But Pharaoh made his heart heavy this time also, and he did not send the people.

familiar.text: And Pharaoh hardened his heart at this time also, neither would he let the people go.

modern.text: But Pharaoh hardened his heart this time as well, and he would not let the people go.

translation_notes: Frog and insect signs continue creation-disruption imagery.
Magicians recognize 'finger of Divine' when imitation fails.
Pharaoh's concessions remain control tactics: worship in land, do not go far, plead for me.
safety_note: The signs confront Pharaoh's repeated refusal and control tactics. Do not read them as Divine cruelty detached from liberation context.
